content: Insurance agent Neha Kapoor followed up with customer Aaradhya Verma regarding a health policy showing as expired despite being renewed. Neha provided a renewal confirmation letter attachment and noted the issue is escalated to the admin team. Aaradhya acknowledged receipt of the letter and requested updates once the system is corrected.

action_items: Resolve the expired policy status in the system
Keep the customer updated on the status of the policy update
